detailed_descriptions_html.en:
SUSPECTS (11 Unique Roles)

Do your crimes. Work together. Don't be too obvious

Commit your role-specific urges to stay sane, but don’t make it obvious.

The longer you wait, the more unstable you become… and the easier it is for others to expose you.

Suspect roles:

Drug Dealer, Junkie, Moonshine Cook, Creep, Scrapper, Pyromaniac, Gambler, Thief, Drunk, Prankster, Hobo

SUPERVISOR

Watch everyone. Figure out who’s doing what, and call the police before it’s too late. Call the police.

But don't forget. You only have power if you have information...

SNITCH

Blend in as a suspect, track everyone’s behavior, and secretly report everything to the Supervisor.

You know more than anyone else.
But if they figure out who you are, you’re done.

MEETINGS

At any moment, the suspects can call a meeting.

Everyone gathers, pretends to be friendly…
and votes on who they think the Snitch is.

Get it wrong, and the real Snitch stays hidden.
Get it right, and the suspects take control.
